130 days later:  
February has 29 days in 1408 (leap year under Gregorian rules, since 1408 divisible by 4).  
Days left in February after Feb 21: 29 − 21 = 8 days → reaches Feb 29.  
130 − 8 = 122 days left.  
March (31) → 31 days → 122 − 31 = 91 left.  
April (30) → 91 − 30 = 61 left.  
May (31) → 61 − 31 = 30 left.  
June 30 days → 30 − 30 = 0 left.  
So lands on June 30, 1408.
